editorNotes.purpose: Original antonym bank for Level 1 Stage 1, meeting the approved 20-item allocation only; not the complete stage bank.
editorNotes.reviewNotes: Original Grade 3 items. Requires editorial and pedagogical review before approval or publication. Extend items are vocabulary applications intended for whole-book study but are not tied to an adopted novel; review their final context when the novel is selected.

questions.prompt: The museum displayed an ancient bowl. Which phrase means the opposite of ancient?

source.reference: Newly authored English Aptitude antonym item for Level 1, Stage 1.

rights.basis: Original prompt and options authored for this project.

feedback.correct: Ancient means very old, so very new is its opposite.
feedback.incorrect: Think about what the word means in this sentence, then choose the phrase with the opposite meaning.

questions.explanation: Ancient means very old, so very new is its opposite.
